judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

R. Suresh Kumar, J.:— Mr Muthuchharan Sundaresh, learned counsel appearing for the appellant, on instructions, seeks withdrawal of these writ appeals. He has also made an endorsement to that effect in the Court bundle.

2. In light of the above, these writ appeals are dismissed as withdrawn. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, all connected civil miscellaneous petitions are closed.
